keyFindings.description: The comment's closing clause ('cannot bring a bit back unnoticed') reads wider than the guard, which roots find at /usr/lib/openssh and /usr/bin/ssh-agent only; 'back there' would be scope-faithful. Wording; docs/kubernetes.md:91-92 states the scope exactly. Fast-follow.

find (-P) tests a symlink itself where the stat anchor dereferences; a future ssh-agent symlink into another directory would print the target's mode and pass the guard. Unreachable today (both regular files in the published layer, tester's census). Hardening: -xtype f. Fast-follow.

chmod g-s on ssh-agent also drops Debian's non-dumpable (anti-ptrace) protection outside a pod (inside, no_new_privs already made the bit inert). No in-tree consumer runs an agent in the image; recorded, nothing to change.
